integrity: Standalone source code and all research documents are embedded with byte counts and SHA-256; finite checks do not constitute an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Even-order finite abelian group tables with n>=6; translation action only. Rational representation classified, integral intercalate exact sequence proved; no claimed integral splitting or equivariant homotopy classification. Uses published general all-field homology theorem.
title: Intercalate correction modules in even-order Latin-square clique homology
